status: checked against cited sources; model-dependent quantities remain conditional

solar_brightening.scope: rough scale around present main-sequence stage; not linear through all future stages

oxygen_model_2021.threshold: oxygen greater than 1% of present atmospheric level
oxygen_model_2021.not: 1% oxygen volume fraction, human breathing deadline, or exact extinction date
oxygen_model_2021.scope: public abstract of Ozaki & Reinhard, distinct model from 2024 plants

land_plants_model_2024.scope: specific weathering/climate assumptions; possible thermal termination instead of carbon starvation; not universal all-life deadline

red_giant_broad_scale.scope: broad transition scale; not maximum radius or first loss of surface habitability

engulfment_model_2008.scope: tip-RGB result with mass loss and tides in one stellar calculation; film rounds to 7.6 billion

equal_flux_orbit_example.scope: flux geometry only, not practical orbital engineering or complete climate preservation

heat: No universal wet-bulb safe/fatal threshold; humidity, airflow, exposure, activity, health and other factors matter.
greenhouse: Moist upper atmosphere and long-term water escape distinguished from runaway radiative instability and from instantaneous ocean evaporation.
current_warming: Primarily human greenhouse forcing; long-term stellar evolution is a separate cause and timescale.
rescue_concepts: Sealed habitats, sunshades, orbital relocation and migration are hypothetical options, not operational or billion-year validated solutions.
no_claims: one merged timeline from different models
